description: Progressively increases traffic in 3 discrete steps (10 -> 25 -> 50 users). Each step is held long enough (60s) for multiple Prometheus scrape cycles (15s).

stages.name: Step 3: High Concurrency
stages.description: Peak load tier (50 users) driving resource pressure

expected_observations: Monotonically increasing request rate stepping from 15 to 65 RPS
Progressive rise in P95 latency, especially in cartservice and productcatalogservice
CPU pressure exceeds 50% threshold on critical leaf nodes
Bottleneck detector flags the primary latency-inducing downstream dependency
DPBPS proposes prioritized scale-up decisions (+1 to +2 replicas)
